messages:
sam: quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need concrete owners and dates for the SLO tweaks and the recurring-incident detection work. who can take what?

anita: i can own the SLO proposal doc + change request. will draft today and ping product for sign-off. target: 48h.

tom: i'll handle the runtime side (adaptive throttling + soft limits for long seqs). plan: reproduce in preprod, then small canary. hope to have a design doc + staging repro by EOW.

elaine: i'll do dashboards/alerts. need the route list and model tags. i'll add per-route p50/p95/p99, rolling burn-rate, and a recurrence alert based on postmortem tag counts. ETA 2d.

sam: thanks. specifics: impacted endpoints were `/v1/generate` with ctx > 2k and `/v1/chat` with >5 turns. current global p95 target = 150ms, incident p95 peaked at ~320ms for large contexts. proposal: create a scoped SLO for "large-context" requests at p95=250ms and leave default 150ms.

anita: scoped SLO needs governance approval. i'll open SLO-change ticket and attach measurement queries + rationale. tagging ops + product in that ticket.

tom: for the throttle: initial idea is queue-length window + kvcache-hit fallback. if kv-hit < 60% AND in-flight > X then shed or throttle long-context. will write thresholds in doc.

elaine: dash ticket created: D-7892. includes panels + alert rule: fires when same root_cause tag appears in 3 incidents within 90d. i'll include a link to postmortem and runbook snippet.

sam: decision point on error budget: i recommend NOT resetting. this is a systemic issue (kvcache stalls) and we should let the burn reflect urgency. any objections?

anita: agree — no reset. we'll treat this as a continuing burn until mitigations land and verify via the new recurrence alert.

tom: quick note: batching changes may reduce throughput for some paths. kevin and infra asked for a small A/B test before rolling default changes. sam, can you coordinate?

sam: yep i'll coordinate A/B with infra. tentative batching PR by +3d, canary 1% then 10%. will post PR link when ready.

ops-bot: Reminder set for 2026-03-25 09:00 UTC to review status (owners: anita, tom, elaine, sam).

elaine: added runbook link on the dash and a "jump to traces" button. also added a widget that shows per-model p95 delta vs baseline.

anita: opened SLO-change ticket SLO-2026-114 with measurement queries and product ops tag. requested sign-off by EOD tomorrow.

tom: posted a short repro guide in the staging channel and linked traces: http://go/trace/INC-2026-442. prototype throttle config in PR-4721 (draft). comments welcome.

sam: summary of owners/dates: anita (SLO ticket + governance) - 48h, elaine (dash + alerts) - 48h, tom (throttle design + PR) - EOW, sam (batching PR + canary) - +3d. we will *not* reset error budget. schedule 2-week follow-up to verify suppression and re-evaluate.

elaine: scheduling follow-up: created calendar invite for 2026-04-08 09:00 UTC and added meeting notes link.

sam: great. if there are no blockers, close out this thread and update each ticket as work progresses. thanks everyone :pray:
